content.short: Gizmolab UI is a DeFi tooling platform.
content.description: Gizmolab UI leverages the Gizmolab Web3 component library, an open-source collection of Web3 building blocks designed to speed up blockchain project development. It provides reusable, fully functional components for building NFT marketplaces, minting platforms, and crypto-enabled e-commerce experiences, enabling seamless integration across projects. With modular, well-documented blocks and clear interfaces, developers can assemble and customize dapps more efficiently, maintain consistency across chains, and reduce boilerplate.
